property_summary: For every caller, Collect atomically debits the caller's balance before any outgoing value call completes, so any re-entrant observation during Collect must see the post-debit balance; the mutant performs the call before debiting, so a re-entrant call in the same transaction observes the stale pre-debit balance.
change_summary: Move the caller's balance subtraction from before the external call to after it, exposing stale balance during reentrancy.
